I found the issue in the `wrap_bare_frontmatter` function—it's filtering out indented lines that start with spaces, which removes YAML list items under keys like `depends:`. The filter was probably meant to skip nested content, but it's inadvertently stripping valid YAML continuations that need those leading spaces.

Looking at the test cases, they only use simple key-value pairs without indented lists, so this bug wouldn't show up there. The filter might have been intended to handle some edge case with the `from_indoc` prefix or to prevent the heuristic from capturing too much body content, but since we're already cutting at blank lines, it's redundant. Let me remove the filter and run the tests to see if that fixes it.

content.text:
Found the bug! In `crates/liwe/src/markdown.rs::wrap_bare_frontmatter`, indented lines are filtered out — but YAML list items under a key like `depends:` are written as `  - foo` (indented). This silently strips list values from bare frontmatter, so `depends:` ends up with no items.

Fenced YAML doesn't go through this filter (early return on `---`), which is why it works there.

Fenced YAML doesn't go through this filter (early return on `---`), which is why it works there.

content.thinking:
I found the issue in the `wrap_bare_frontmatter` function—it's filtering out indented lines that start with spaces, which removes YAML list items under keys like `depends:`. The filter was probably meant to skip nested content, but it's inadvertently stripping valid YAML continuations that need those leading spaces.

Looking at the test cases, they only use simple key-value pairs without indented lists, so this bug wouldn't show up there. The filter might have been intended to handle some edge case with the `from_indoc` prefix or to prevent the heuristic from capturing too much body content, but since we're already cutting at blank lines, it's redundant. Let me remove the filter and run the tests to see if that fixes it.

```rust
.filter(|l| !l.starts_with(' '))
```

YAML list items are written as `  - foo` (indented under their parent key). That filter silently dropped them, so a doc like:

```
title: Foo
depends:
  - foo
```

became `---\ntitle: Foo\ndepends:\n---`, leaving `depends` as null with no list members. `iwe find --meta depends=foo` therefore matched nothing. Fenced (`---`) frontmatter took the early-return path and bypassed this stripping, so it worked.

## Fix

## Diagnosis

In `crates/liwe/src/markdown.rs`, `wrap_bare_frontmatter` synthesizes `---` fences around bare frontmatter so pulldown-cmark's `MetadataBlock` machinery can pick it up. Before wrapping, it filtered out every line beginning with a space:

```rust
.filter(|l| !l.starts_with(' '))
```

YAML list items are written as `  - foo` (indented under their parent key). That filter silently dropped them, so a doc like:

```
title: Foo
depends:
  - foo
```

became `---\ntitle: Foo\ndepends:\n---`, leaving `depends` as null with no list members. `iwe find --meta depends=foo` therefore matched nothing. Fenced (`---`) frontmatter took the early-return path and bypassed this stripping, so it worked.

## Fix

`crates/liwe/src/markdown.rs`: removed the `filter(|l| !l.starts_with(' '))` cleanup — the blank-line split already bounds the header, and indented YAML continuation lines must be preserved verbatim.

Added a regression test `bare_frontmatter_preserves_yaml_list_values` in `crates/liwe/tests/bare_frontmatter_test.rs` that imports a bare-frontmatter doc with a `depends:` list and asserts the parsed metadata contains both list items.

`cargo test` is fully green.

content.thinking: I need to check how the markdown parser handles frontmatter—specifically, `pulldown_cmark` supports YAML metadata blocks when they're fenced with `---`, but bare frontmatter requires preprocessing first.

I found the issue in the `wrap_bare_frontmatter` function—it's filtering out indented lines that start with spaces, which removes YAML list items under keys like `depends:`. The filter was probably meant to skip nested content, but it's inadvertently stripping valid YAML continuations that need those leading spaces.

Looking at the test cases, they only use simple key-value pairs without indented lists, so this bug wouldn't show up there. The filter might have been intended to handle some edge case with the `from_indoc` prefix or to prevent the heuristic from capturing too much body content, but since we're already cutting at blank lines, it's redundant. Let me remove the filter and run the tests to see if that fixes it.

Found the bug! In `crates/liwe/src/markdown.rs::wrap_bare_frontmatter`, indented lines are filtered out — but YAML list items under a key like `depends:` are written as `  - foo` (indented). This silently strips list values from bare frontmatter, so `depends:` ends up with no items.

Fenced YAML doesn't go through this filter (early return on `---`), which is why it works there.
